name: com.avarisk/avarisk
title: AvaRisk
description: Official avalanche forecasts, reports and bulletins in English for the Alps, Pyrenees and beyond.

tools.name: find-regions
tools.description: Find avalanche forecast regions, each with today's official avalanche danger level, for avalanche forecast, avalanche report, avalanche bulletin or avalanche risk questions. Search by a place name (ski resort, town, peak or massif) or by coordinates. A mountain range ("Northern Alps", "Valais") or a country ("Switzerland") returns every region in it, so use this, not one get-avalanche-forecast call per region, to compare regions. Coordinates outside every region return nothing rather than a far-away region. Returns region slugs to pass to get-avalanche-forecast.

query.description: A town, resort or massif ("Chamonix", "Cairngorms"), or a mountain range or country for all its regions ("Northern Alps", "Switzerland").

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees. Give with longitude to find the regions nearest a point.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees. Give with latitude.

tools.name: get-avalanche-forecast
tools.description: Get the official avalanche forecast (avalanche report or bulletin) for an AvaRisk region, by slug from find-regions or by name: today's avalanche danger level, by elevation or treeline band, how it changes during the day, the slopes most affected, the avalanche problems and key messages, tomorrow's level once issued (no service forecasts further ahead), and links to the issuing service's official bulletin.

region.description: The region slug returned by find-regions, such as "mont-blanc".
